name: Item Fallback (sample)
description: Sample for what players without a mod see of its items (Kiln.Replication's item remap): two new items, a Frost Can that declares a vanilla look-alike (the game's watering can) and a Frost Charm that does not. A player without Kiln, or a Kiln player without this mod, sees a watering can where the Frost Can is and an empty slot where the Frost Charm is; nothing they are sent names an item their game does not know.
